limitations: All scores are provisional browser judgments based on the attached still images, chronological filmstrips and supplied runtime account; I did not independently execute the reported tests.
Normal, enlarged and corresponding transition variants are grouped under their represented screen or state; focused and pressed variants also inform individual component grades.
The supplied browser evidence supports strong recovery, keyboard operation, contrast, draft preservation and reduced-motion behavior; it does not establish repeated novice-use outcomes.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native keyboard, haptics, tilt, actual OS sharing, native notifications and native performance remain deferred, with no deductions solely for those boundaries.
Several captures are visibly scrolled or constrained; content outside their viewport is not treated as proven clipping or an unreachable action.
Filmstrips support judgments about sampled visual continuity, not frame rate or unsampled animation behavior; browser timing claims come only from the supplied runtime measurements.
The stationary foreground-bounds probe does not establish continuous background depth, parallax or the independence of painted layers.
Synthetic reading and source text is treated as layout-fixture content, not a production-copy defect or evidence of predictive quality.
No demonstrated hard-gate failure is established by this evidence; the requested per-item A>=9 and F>=9 browser threshold is nevertheless not met.
For each item, A is the mean of its applicable first three dimensions and F the mean of its applicable last three; overall is 0.4A + 0.6F rounded to one decimal.
topFixes: Improve room transitions: retain recognizable landmarks and synchronize background focus with destination content instead of exposing dark intermediate layers.
Rebalance enlarged check-in screens so the exact forecast remains present without pushing outcome status and Save so far apart.
Improve dense centered explanations through stronger passage grouping, quieter publisher headings and consistent section rhythm.
Strengthen physical integration of tall parchment, preview frames and destination thumbnails through restrained mounting, edge thickness and contact shadows.
Make pressed states more visibly distinct and provide direct keyboard-focus and target-size evidence for the small room destination controls.
Compact enlarged disclosures, invitation copy and profile actions so their next controls are easier to discover without reducing text accessibility.
